Documentary 'Being Heumann' to Open Toronto Film Festival

Sian Heder's documentary 'Being Heumann' has been selected to open the 51st Toronto International Film Festival. The film focuses on the life and work of Judith Heumann, a prominent disability rights activist. The festival is scheduled to take place in Toronto.
